name: KurdishNewsQA
description: A QA dataset built over Kurdish news articles for evaluating question-answering systems on reading comprehension in Kurdish.
evaluation_method: Exact Match and F1 (span-based QA metrics)
reputation: A niche, low-resource-language benchmark useful for Kurdish NLP research with limited adoption outside the Kurdish/NLP community.
notes: Low-resource language dataset; may be relatively small and contain annotation noise. Risk of limited comparability to high-resource QA benchmarks and potential domain bias toward news articles.
